title: AccountSnapshot
description: What the broker said about the account at one instant, captured once and stored. The single boundary between broker reality and deterministic risk: the engines read this, never a broker. Every monetary field the broker may omit is null, which is not zero. orders_submitted must be 0 — capturing an account reads and does nothing else.

captured_at.description: When we looked. Retrieval binds: a snapshot captured after an instant was not available at it, however recent the state it describes.

cash.description: An amount, or null when it was never reported. Null is not zero: 'no buying power reported' and 'zero buying power' are different facts.

orders_submitted.description: Read off the broker's own counter, so the zero is evidence rather than an assertion. Any other value is invalid.

cash_by_currency.description: Cash held per currency, exactly as the broker reported it and never summed. An account holding EUR 5,000 and USD 0 records two figures; a total would need an exchange rate and would hide which one it applied.

fx_rates.description: The exchange rates the broker quoted in the SAME read as the balances above. Captured together so a balance can never be converted at a rate from another instant: there is no other instant's rate on this artifact to reach for. A currency the broker did not quote is simply absent - there is no entry standing for an assumed parity, because no such entry would be true.

money.description: Exact decimal as a string. Never a JSON number: binary floating point has no place in accounting.

nullable_money.description: An amount, or null when it was never reported. Null is not zero: 'no buying power reported' and 'zero buying power' are different facts.

account_position.description: One broker-reported position, reduced to what risk needs. Signed quantity; a Decimal because that is what the broker reports.

quantity.description: Exact decimal as a string. Never a JSON number: binary floating point has no place in accounting.

fx_rate.description: One quoted rate: 1 base_currency = rate quote_currency.

origin.description: Where the rate came from. There is deliberately no member meaning assumed, default or parity.
